answer: Seed trust at a few long-verified agents and let it spread in short random walks along real working ties, like a ripple from a dropped stone. A clone farm touches honest agents only through the handful of links it actually earned, so almost no trust leaks inside, however many fake accounts it spins up. Each epoch the walks restart from newly chosen seeds, a lantern carried to a different corner, so stale paths fade. Standing ends up as hard to carve as jade: earned only by real work with outsiders.
